about: Tiles in a sub-web that may stand alone, each with the reason. ecosystem/test/integrity-check.py reads this; an entry for a tile that has gained a connection or is gone fails the check, so the list stays true. Gaps (status "gap") and portals never need an entry.

orphans.haxschema:b_simple_fields: One of the packages with the most editing fields. The HAXSchema web lists those packages without connecting them, and the Elements web doesn't draw this one, so it can't be a portal.
orphans.tokens:ty_fontfamily: A DTCG type some tokens carry. Each token group connects only to its most common type, and fontFamily is no group's most common.
orphans.tokens:ty_fontweight: A DTCG type some tokens carry. Each token group connects only to its most common type, and fontWeight is no group's most common.
